source_screen: Global brand Toast; 2026-10-22 user-specified presentation, not an original HTML screen
trigger: Close icon click or Enter / Space keyboard activation; bounded automatic dismissal
preconditions: An active Toast exists; callbacks carry the current notification ID
visible_feedback: Soft exit animation; reduced-motion preference removes motion; does not steal focus or block outside gestures
success_result: Only the matching Toast closes; its timer is cancelled; source transient error may clear so the same action can be retried
failure_result: Old ID or stale timeout is ignored; a newer Toast and all business state remain unchanged
persistence: none; toast lifecycle is not a report, preference, message, purchase or authentication write
sync_scope: One global presentation host across all routes; success navigation and app background clear stale feedback
acceptance: scripts/toast.test.mjs; scripts/toast-browser.test.mjs; scripts/lib/toast-regression.mjs in iPhone 17 Pro EventCoverTests; no full-app verified claim
